text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's a voice coming from my office. I crack open the door and take a peek to find…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Ngh… Why can't I move?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Come on, El! Don't make me count to three!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: You can't lose, El! You gotta do a bunch of trainin' today too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's hyping herself up, but she looks like she's about to collapse…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like I need to reconsider her race schedule before she burns out…
